main_text.l: Esaiæ prophetia plenius fuerit impleta in ea, ad quam
ex omnibus omninino Gentibus usque in hodiernum diem
22. Habete fidem Dei. Hebraismus, id est, fidem magnam
seu pleniffimam, quam alibi comparavit Christus grano si-
pro quovis opere factu difficili, spēmque humanam superante.

page.notes: The scan is cropped at the left: the strip of letters along the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. Some words are doubtful in the print, e.g. "fpēmque" (spemque with a macron over e), "Ponitur., unum", and "Efaiæ". The catchword "C A-" is set at the right below the last line.
